evidence.quote: Spineart was founded in Geneva, Switzerland, in 2005. We deliver patented, clinically validated technologies in minimally invasive surgery, motion preservation, 3D-printed implants, and robotic guidance, improving patient outcomes worldwide. || Spineart has over 370 employees, serving 60 countries around the world. || Spineart partners with surgeons and hospitals in 60+ countries to accelerate the adoption of advanced spine technologies that support patient care.
